Hi Sophie — thanks for the note. Attaching the vendor activation packet and a draft SLA matrix for your review (redwood_sla_template_v1.pdf). Below is a short checklist to expedite vendor setup:

Redwood vendor activation checklist (initial):
- Completed onboarding form (attached: procureplus_onboarding_form_filled.pdf when you return it)
- W-9 or equivalent tax form (US entities)
- Signed PO referencing Deal ID: DEAL-2025-288
- Primary billing contact + billing email and remit address
- Invoice frequency and payment terms (Net30 default; note any exceptions)
- Copy of relevant insurance certificate (if required under contract)
- Technical contacts for integration and their Slack/phone for SE handoff

Support & escalation summary (high level):
- Level 1 (Support): support@redwood.com — response within 2 hours (business hours)
- Level 2 (Engineering escalation): eng-oncall@redwood.com — response within 4 hours
- Level 3 (SRE/Incident): sre@redwood.com and on-call phone +1-650-555-0123 — response within 1 hour for Sev1
- SLA uptime target (hosted API): 99.9% monthly availability; Dedicated tiers discuss 99.95% depending on contract
- Scheduled maintenance windows: announced 72h in advance; emergency maintenance communicated via status.redwood.com and email

PO / finance notes:
- Default billing terms: Net30 once invoice received and taxes validated
- Invoices should reference the Deal ID and Redwood vendor ID (to be provided after onboarding)
- Submit invoices to invoices@redwood.com and cc billing@redwood.com

Attachments included: redwood_sla_template_v1.pdf (SLA matrix & escalation form)

If you send the completed onboarding form and the signed PO, we'll kick off vendor ID creation and schedule a short technical handoff.

Best,
